_what: Per-platform capability matrix for TOS delivery: what an INDIVIDUAL teacher's account can actually run, as dated, sourced facts. Statuses: available | unavailable | unverified (never guessed). UNTESTED-live marks a vendor-documented capability no one has exercised on a real teacher account yet.
_why: User decision (R5): plan-gated capabilities are feature flags, not assumptions. Docs and tools/build_teacher_pack.py read THIS file; a vendor change is a one-line status flip here, and check 24 (dated manifests) plus tools/platform_watch.py keep it from rotting silently.
_rules: Every status carries source + checked. A claim without a vendor page is at best unverified. Sources verified by the 2026-09-25 research rounds (research-manager graded); the full research record is retained off-repo (delivered to the maintainer 2026-09-25), and every status stands on its inline source URL.

code_cli.note: Loader scans skill dirs ONE level deep; the manifest skills array (R5-A2) is what makes 62/62 load. Verified with claude plugin details 2.1.282. R8: plugin mcpServers runs the compiled tos-tools.mcpb release bundle — Connected with NO python/node/uv on PATH (tested, Claude Code 2.1.289). Claude Code does not supply Node and ignores uv-type bundles (tested). 2026-11-25: Claude Code reads AGENTS.md when no CLAUDE.md exists (v2.1.277+), or through an @AGENTS.md import (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory).

desktop_chat.note: 'You can install and use plugins in chat on the web, the Chat tab in Claude Desktop, and Claude Cowork.' Plugin local MCP runs in Cowork/Code; .mcpb covers Desktop chat tools. Desktop >= v2.9939.2 for plugins containing a .zip. R8: the .mcpb is type 'binary' with per-OS platform_overrides (one universal2 macOS build) — nothing to install. Gatekeeper/SmartScreen behavior on a real Mac/PC: UNTESTED-live (R8 phase 5).

web_chat_paid.install: plugin via Customize (upload or GitHub marketplace)
web_chat_paid.note: 'A plugin's local MCP server runs in Cowork and Claude Code, not in chat.' Browser cannot reach localhost.

web_chat_free.install: Project file upload; 1 custom remote connector allowed
web_chat_free.note: Plugins are documented for paid plans only.

teachers_plan.note: UNTESTED-live. 'A free Claude for Teams plan' with Claude Code + Cowork; its disabled-features list does NOT include plugins/connectors/extensions — inference, not a statement. Training off. One free year for signups by 2027-06-30. District domain claims can absorb the account later.

desktop_workcodex_personal.install: local marketplace (~/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json + ~/.codex/plugins/) or Settings > MCP servers > STDIO
desktop_workcodex_personal.note: UNTESTED-live end-to-end. Codex on every plan incl. Free/Go; Work on paid plans (desktop; staged rollout). openai/codex source: plugin stdio servers ARE spawned; ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is NOT expanded in MCP args (use the Agent-Plugins mcp.json with ${PLUGIN_ROOT}, or cwd '.'); manifest skills paths must start with './'; initialize offers 2025-06-18; Windows resolves commands PATHEXT-style, python3 is NOT mapped to python. R8: stays on Python — Codex expands ${PLUGIN_ROOT} only in args (command must be a bare token) and has no per-OS override, so a bundled executable cannot be named portably; Codex also needs the runtime on PATH (openai/codex#31897). 2026-11-25: repo marketplaces live at $REPO_ROOT/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json and may point at a git-subdir source with a ref; the desktop app also reads .claude-plugin/marketplace.json as legacy-compatible (developers.openai.com/plugins/build/plugins). Codex finds repo skills in .agents/skills; the initial skills list is capped at 2% of context or 8,000 characters.

web_personal.install: Project + reference pack; plugin skills where the plan allows
web_personal.note: Plugins (skills + connected apps) now work in Chat and Work on ChatGPT web, desktop and mobile from one directory shared with Codex (developers.openai.com/codex/plugins); installing one 'depends on your plan, workspace, role, region' (help 20001256), and standalone skill upload is Business/Enterprise/Healthcare/Edu (help 20001066), so personal plans stay UNVERIFIED. A plugin with a local (stdio) server is Desktop only; web still cannot reach localhost. Custom GPTs retire 2026-12-11 (help 20001519).

teachers_plan.note: Weakest path. Skills + plugin upload/GitHub import are documented for Business/Enterprise/(Healthcare)/Edu, never Teachers; Codex pricing page omits Teachers; a Jan-2026 OpenAI-contributor comment said Codex 'isn't provided' there (possibly superseded). Free through June 2028, training off, self-serve workspace possible. OpenAI's own K-12 plugin: district-claimed workspaces only.

antigravity_personal.install: plugin: /plugin -> install from a local directory, or agy plugin install <folder>; skills -> .agents/skills or ~/.gemini/config/skills; plugin MCP -> mcp_config.json
antigravity_personal.note: UNTESTED-live. Personal Google account, 18+, approved regions; NOT for school accounts. Free weekly quota. Client probes server/discover (2026-07-28) FIRST and needs -32601 to fall back (R5-A1 provides it). Terms allow interaction review/training unless Settings > Account > Telemetry is off — default not stated, tell teachers to check. R8: stays on Python — the pack installer is itself a Python script, so its users are already at Level 1; the compiled launcher adds nothing here. 2026-11-25: native plugins (plugin.json, mcp_config.json, rules/, hooks) replace the hand-merged global config; agy plugin import claude migrates Claude Code plugins (untested for TOS).

gemini_cli.install: retired for individuals — migrate to Antigravity CLI (agy)
gemini_cli.note: 'Starting June 18, 2026, Gemini Code Assist IDE Extensions and Gemini CLI stopped serving requests for the Gemini Code Assist for individuals, Google AI Pro, and Google AI Ultra tiers.' New Code Assist Standard/Enterprise subscriptions can no longer be bought since 2026-10-09 (auto-renewal ends in 2027). Gemini CLI's own quota page still describes a free tier; the release notes are newer. Successor: gemini.antigravity_cli.

gemini_app.install: Gem with <=10 knowledge files (upload-rule cap) or a Gemini Notebook source; Classroom Gem = 10 sources
gemini_app.note: Custom MCP 'apps' take a remote URL only (18+, US, English, personal accounts; not work/school). Personal accounts: Keep Activity on by default, human review + training — warn before student-adjacent use. School accounts: no review/training (edition-dependent).

antigravity_cli.note: UNTESTED-live. Google's successor to Gemini CLI; reads GEMINI.md and AGENTS.md; MCP in ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json or a plugin's mcp_config.json (${PLUGIN_ROOT} expanded in args/cwd/env, not in command); SSE servers unsupported. Personal Google account; Google Workspace plans don't include Antigravity plans (antigravity.google/docs/install).
